title: Batch Sentry — incremental workload fingerprinting and conservative config apply
creator: Aisha N. Patel
description: Build 'Batch Sentry' — an incremental, conservative recommendation and apply system for batching + KV-caching configuration. Goals: 1) generate per-workload fingerprints (request shape, seq len, KV reuse) with lightweight continuous profiling, 2) synthesize conservative batching + cache parameter proposals, 3) validate through simulated dry-run and shadow/canary apply, 4) automatic rollback on regression signals. This ticket covers the profiler, heuristics engine, safety checks for apply/rollback and the runbook for operators.
acceptance_criteria: Profiler emits workload fingerprints every 6 hours with schema (avg_seq, seq_p95, kv_reuse_ratio, req_rate, tail_latency_dist)
Heuristic engine produces a ranked set of batch/cache proposals with estimated token-cost delta and risk score
Simulation/dry-run can run on a 24h window and report expected P50/P95 latency and cost change; must match real shadow within 10% for test workloads
Safe-apply flow: shadow apply -> 1% canary -> 5% -> 20% ramp with automatic rollback rules
Rollback triggers: increase in P95 latency > 10% OR error rate increase > 0.5% OR request success SLO drop below configured threshold
Telemetry dashboards (per-workload) show cost delta, latency delta, and a human-ack step before production apply
